claim.statement:
∀ path : List Bool,
    let m := (MathGKM.Markov.frame path).mid
    let d := m.a+m.b-1
    MathGKM.Markov.totalComponent m.p (d-1) =
      (((m.b-1:ℕ):ℤ) • MathGKM.Markov.U + ((m.a-1:ℕ):ℤ) • MathGKM.Markov.V)*
      (MathGKM.Markov.U+MathGKM.Markov.V)^(d-2)
